item.text: [{"task_id":"b7f8a4d8","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    skip = max(0, int(round(params['rule'][1])))","    required = max(1, int(round(params['rule'][2])))","    ranked = []","    for value in np.unique(grid):","        color = int(value)","        if color != background:","            ranked.append((int(np.count_nonzero(grid == color)), color))","    ranked.sort(reverse=True)","    colors = [item[1] for item in ranked[skip:]]","    result = grid.copy()","    for direction in params['directions']:","        turns = int(round(direction))","        original = np.rot90(grid, turns)","        working = np.rot90(result, turns).copy()","        for color in colors:","            for row in range(len(original)):","                positions = np.nonzero(original[row] == color)[0]","                if len(positions) >= required:","                    start = int(positions[0])","                    stop = int(positions[-1])","                    segment = working[row, start:stop]","                    working[row, start:stop] = np.where(segment == background, color, segment)","        result = np.rot90(working, -turns).copy()","    return result"],"shapes":{"rule":[3],"directions":[2]},"params":{"rule":[0,2,2],"directions":[0,1]},"rationale":"The two most frequent nonbackground colors form the frames and ordinary interiors. Connect matching exceptional interiors horizontally and vertically between their outermost occurrences, coloring only background gaps and preserving all existing cells. Tensor values specify background, excluded frequency ranks, minimum endpoint count, and connection directions."}]
